title: Hexus Go Replacement Vape Pod
description: The Hexus Go 2+10 Replacement Pod is designed specifically for the Hexus Go 2+10 Refillable Pod Kit. It features a refillable 2ml pod paired with a built-in 10ml refill reservoir, giving you extended vaping time and the flexibility to use any 50/50 or nicotine salt e-liquid you prefer. Fitted with a 0.6ohm dual mesh coil, the pod delivers smooth, flavourful vapour with consistent performance across a wide range of e-liquids. The side-fill port on the 2ml pod allows for quick top-ups, while the integrated 10ml reservoir automatically replenishes the pod as you vape—minimising hassle and downtime. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this combined pod and refill unit is designed to be replaced when performance starts to fade. Just slot in a fresh pod to continue enjoying great flavour without adjusting your setup.
